title: Htmx 4.0
summary: Htmx 4.0 is a major release of the JavaScript library that enables dynamic web interactions using pure HTML attributes. This version marks a significant milestone with improved performance, better ESM support, and updated dependencies.
problem_solved: Simplifies building interactive web applications by allowing developers to use HTML attributes instead of writing complex JavaScript for AJAX, WebSockets, and server-sent events.
why_valuable: Reduces frontend complexity and improves developer productivity by leveraging hypermedia as the core interaction model, making web development more accessible.
